notes: Identity verified independently: supplied text has matching title Unique Affective Profile of Music-Evoked Nostalgia: An Extension and Conceptual Replication of Barrett et al.’s (2010) Study, authors Sarah Hennessy, Timothy Greer, Shrikanth Narayanan, Assal Habibi, and DOI 10.1037/emo0001389. It is the primary research article (2024 advance online publication), with Methods, Results, Discussion, tables and references through printed p.23; not merely an abstract. No PDF was supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. The requested standardized beta is not established: context variables were raw and not standardized; person scores were mean-centered, not described as standardized. Printed β coefficients and Cohen’s f² candidates are retained without conversion.
